name: space
doc: Physical things. A thing that has two or three dimensions is sized, and its size is its extent in each.

types.name: Extent2
types.doc: A two-dimensional extent: width and height, in metres.

types.name: Extent3
types.doc: A three-dimensional extent: width, height, and depth, in metres.

types.name: Dimensions
types.doc: How many dimensions a physical thing has, and its extent in them. Bounds apply to integers only, so a negative length is not refused here.

types.name: Sized
types.doc: Anything physical. A thing is sized when it has a size in two or three dimensions.
